content.title: Lendeborg’s rise fueled by mother’s fight
content.text: National profiles shine light on Lendeborg family amid NCAA tournament As Michigan advances to the Sweet 16, national outlets have spotlighted Yaxel Lendeborg’s bond with his mother, Yissel Raposo, whose influence has been central to his career. Coverage from People and CNN details how her intervention rescued his academic and athletic prospects, while GBMWolverine highlighted her courtside pride during his standout performances. This attention has framed Lendeborg’s tournament run as both a personal and family triumph. GBMWolverine + 2 Why Yissel Raposo’s story resonates beyond basketball Raposo’s journey from Dominican Republic national team athlete to single-minded advocate for her son’s future carries a universal theme of parental sacrifice. She balanced work, family responsibilities, and navigating Yaxel’s struggles with depression and academic ineligibility, even leveraging her sports network to secure him a college opportunity. Now undergoing chemotherapy, her resilience continues to inspire both her son and fans following their story. CNN + 1 From the court to the sidelines: family and coach perspectives Michigan coach Dusty May describes Lendeborg as 'pure and genuine,' a quality reinforced by seeing his warmth with family before key games. Raposo’s visible presence at tournament matches, despite medical advice to rest, underscores her unwavering support. This dynamic mirrors Lendeborg’s own transformation from a reluctant teen to a hard-working leader, a shift May attributes to the family’s closeness and values. CNN + 1 A family built on athletic excellence Both Yissel Raposo and Okary Lendeborg represented the Dominican Republic in basketball, with Raposo also competing in volleyball. This athletic pedigree, combined with early guidance from Yaxel’s grandfather, laid the foundation for his physical skills and competitive mindset. The family’s multi-sport background reflects a broader tradition of sports dynasties where generational talent and mentorship fuel elite performance. People + 1 4 references More for you
